Before you launch

What this player does

Games open in a sandboxed frame inside this page. Nothing is downloaded, installed or linked out. A loaded frame means the host page opened — it is not a claim that the game itself runs, and no external launch is ever offered.

Honest status

Playable here only when the current player settings list the game as iframe and its catalogue record is not sandbox-pending. Everything else keeps its record and shows why it cannot start.

Saved locally

Favourites and recently opened game IDs live in this browser's local storage only. No game progress, scores or completion state is recorded.
